chunks: Indeed, a man from the Ansar married while he was in the state of ihram, so the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم invalidated his marriage.

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: the Ansar, the Helpers of Madinah
key_terms.تَزَوَّجَ: he married; he entered into a marriage contract
key_terms.فَأَبْطَلَ: so he invalidated; he nullified legally
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: Is a marriage contract valid while a person is in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a man from the Ansar contracted marriage while in the state of ihram, and the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم annulled that marriage. It indicates the legal impermissibility and invalidity of performing a marriage contract during ihram.
